reviewCorrections: PostShare.sharedById and ContentReport.reporterId are profile identities, unlike Presence account and ProfileView viewer-account identities.
Notification sender/resource/action exclusions align with J21; raw saved counterpart titles and unverified activity text are excluded.
Community/business governance is shared; select narrow subject participation/registration receipts rather than assuming administrators own whole rows.
Guardian/membership audits distinguish actor-account and subject/dependent branches and exclude unmatched participant identities/private payload.
Migration, volatile notification state, mixed operational logs and configuration inputs each have explicit store policy.
Validator compares junction columns against actual metadata and all physical tables/columns; inventory declarations cannot redefine the expected schema.
limits: Policy coverage does not implement or verify J24 capture enforcement. Existing partial/unfenced previews are not promoted to complete.
No per-row historical identity proof or consent is inferred; ambiguous attribution remains labeled/uncovered.
Typed-projection actions prohibit raw passthrough and require implementation and row-level proof in the relevant J24 slice.
Post/Poll persistence is unverified; its relation is explicitly excluded while owned Poll definitions remain separately selectable.
Operational log sinks and retention depend on deployment; this source-visible exclusion inventory is not log discovery, deletion or lifecycle qualification.
No user-facing UI, schema or migration change in J23. No media bytes, downloadable artifacts, deletion, external flow, remote CI or production qualification.
